content: To determine the timestamp and to compute the timestamp differences, the fun ction WdgM_CheckpointReached shall use OS function GetElapsed Value , using as 1 st parameter the CounterID that is configured for the Supervised Entity . To determine the timestamp and to compute the timestamp differences, the function WdgM_CheckpointReached (for detection of both early arrivals and delays) and the function WdgM_MainFunction (for detection of timeouts) shall use OS function GetElapsedValue , using as 1 st parameter the CounterID that is configured for the Supervised Entity (see WdgMOSCounter , EC UC_WdgM_00361)
